class.name: InputModifier
class.brief_description: Transforms the value of one physical binding.
class.description: Add a [InputDeadZone], [InputSwapAxis], [InputInvert], [InputScale], [InputNormalize], or [InputResponseCurve] resource to [member InputBinding.modifiers]. Controls applies the stack from first to last before combining the binding with other sources for the action. Each Controls scope copies the modifier settings when it boots.
